content.title: Packaging Corp.: Q4 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: The Lake Forest, Illinois-based company said it had profit of $1.13 per share. Earnings, adjusted for non-recurring costs, were $2.32 per share. The results fell short of Wall Street expectations.

content.title: Packaging Corporation of America (NYSE:PKG) Misses Q4 CY2025 Sales Expectations
content.summary: Packaging Corporation of America (NYSE:PKG) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, but sales rose 10.1% year on year to $2.36 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.32 per share was 3.9% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: PCA (PKG) Q2 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
content.summary: Good morning, everyone, and thank you all for participating in Packaging Corporation of America's Second Quarter 2025 Earnings Release Conference Call today.
